_comment: Manual license determinations for installed packages whose metadata does
not expose a useful identifier or complete terms. Each override must cite
the bundled license file, package metadata, or official upstream page.
Regenerate the inventory after changing this file.

antlr4-python3-runtime.evidence: The official ANTLR 4.9.3 LICENSE.txt supplies the BSD-3-Clause terms for ANTLR and MIT notices for its included JavaScript-derived code: https://github.com/antlr/antlr4/blob/4.9.3/LICENSE.txt

cuda-toolkit.evidence: No license file is shipped in the wheel. The current NVIDIA Toolkit inventory identifies the governing terms as the NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit EULA: https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/eula/

google-crc32c.evidence: Bundled LICENSE file contains the Apache License 2.0. This matches the current NVIDIA Toolkit inventory.

imageio-ffmpeg.evidence: The Python wrapper is BSD-2-Clause. The 0.6.0 Linux wheel also bundles ffmpeg-linux-x86_64-v7.0.2; `-version` reports `--enable-gpl --enable-version3 --enable-static --enable-libx264 --enable-libx265`, making that executable GPL-3.0-or-later. Upstream confirms its wheels include the FFmpeg executable: https://github.com/imageio/imageio-ffmpeg
